components.heading: Section 2. Bus routes – Filed with City Clerk.
components.text: The Authority shall operate its buses initially over routes as shown on a map provided to the City Clerk and, as changes are made in said routes, the Authority shall provide notice to the City Clerk of route changes and a map showing the route changes. (Ord. 19853 § 2, 9-24-13.)
